summary: Kaniksu NF summit in Pend Oreille County: a 1937 crow's nest, then a 1940 50-ft L-4 pole tower, phased out by 1950; a few footings and anchors remain per a 2023 visit.

facts.design: 50-foot cable-braced pole tower with L-4 cab (1940), preceded by a crow's nest (1937)
facts.status_note: Tower phased out by 1950; Willhite's 2023 visit found a few footings and bolts and anchors on the summit

visit.trail_note: Half a mile each way with about 300 feet of gain, per Willhite; a spur road to the summit was blocked by fallen trees in 2023. No source says whether the site is open to visitors.

notes_for_editor: Firetower.org, FireLookout.com and Willhite agree on the 1937 crow's nest, the 1940 pole tower and the phase-out by 1950. Only Willhite describes the site today, from a 2023 visit. The 'phased out' wording is coded as abandoned; the sources do not say the tower was removed, though Forest Lookouts marks it removed without a date. The height of 15.2 m is the 50-foot tower figure converted to metres. The sources read say nothing about Usk beyond FireLookout.com's '13 miles NE of Usk' line, so no further Usk history is given. Access level is omitted because no source says whether the site is public.
